panels.rationale: Single clinical photograph of the open mouth in a patient with herpangina, with the caption and article title specifically describing an ulcerative/vesicular lesion over the uvula. Visible palatal vesicles and pharyngeal erythema are consistent with herpangina. The arrow annotation supports the uvular lesion.
